cases.sentence: Давид осмотрел людей, которые были с ним, и назначил над ними тысячников и ___.
cases.translation: David counted the people who were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
cases.explain: The verb 'назначить' (to appoint) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Давид отправил войска, треть под началом Иава, треть под началом сына Саруи Авишая, брата Иава, и треть под началом Гатянина ___.
cases.translation: David sent the people out, a third under Joab, a third under Abishai, and a third under Ittai the Gittite.
cases.explain: The preposition 'под началом' (under the command of) followed by a genitive indicates the leader.

cases.sentence: Царь сказал воинам, «Я сам непременно выступлю вместе с ___».
cases.translation: The king said to the people, 'I will also surely go out with you myself.'
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (with) indicating accompanying takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Но люди сказали, «Не ходи. Если мы будем вынуждены бежать, они не обратят на это внимания. Даже если половина из нас погибнет, они не обратят внимания, но ты стоишь десяти тысяч из ___».
cases.translation: But the people said, 'You shall not go out; for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us. But you are worth ten thousand of us.'
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the number десять тысяч (ten thousand).

cases.sentence: Царь приказал Иоаву, Авишаю и Итаю, «Ради меня обращайтесь с юношей о ___».
cases.translation: The king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, 'Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom.'
cases.explain: The preposition о (about/concerning) takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Войско выступило в поле, чтобы сразиться с Израилем, и битва произошла в лесу ___.
cases.translation: So the people went out into the field against Israel; and the battle was in the forest of Ephraim.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with prepositional phrases of location following proper nouns.

cases.sentence: А Виссалому случилось встретиться с людьми Давида, он был на своем муле. И когда мул пробегал под большим дубом, голова Виссалома застряла в густых ветвях и сам он остался висеть в ___.
cases.translation: Absalom happened to meet David's servants. Absalom was riding on his mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the sky and earth.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Они взяли Авесолома, бросили его в большую яму в лесу и воздвигли над ним огромную груду ___.
cases.translation: They took Absalom and cast him into a great pit in the forest, and raised over him a very great heap of stones.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after 'груда' (heap) to indicate what is piled up.

reading.ru: Давид осмотрел людей, которые были с ним, и назначил над ними тысячников и сотников.
reading.question: What did David do to organize his people for battle?
options: He counted them and appointed captains of thousands and hundreds
He sent scouts to survey the enemy
He gathered them for a prayer service
He divided them into different groups by tribe
reading.correct: He counted them and appointed captains of thousands and hundreds
reading.explain: The text states: 'Давид осмотрел людей, которые были с ним, и назначил над ними тысячников и сотников' — David counted the people with him and appointed captains of thousands and hundreds.

reading.ru: Давид отправил войска, треть под началом Иава, треть под началом сына Саруи Авишая, брата Иава, и треть под началом Гатянина Итая.
reading.question: How did David divide his forces?
options: Into thirds under Joab, Abishai, and Ittai
Into halves between north and south
reading.correct: Into thirds under Joab, Abishai, and Ittai
reading.explain: The text says: 'Давид отправил войска, треть под началом Иава, треть под началом сына Саруи Авишая...и треть под началом Гатянина Итая' — David sent the people out in thirds under Joab, Abishai, and Ittai.

reading.ru: Царь сказал воинам, «Я сам непременно выступлю вместе с вами.» Но люди сказали, «Не ходи.»
reading.question: What did David want to do, and how did his men respond?
options: David wanted to go with them; the men told him not to go
David wanted to stay; the men asked him to go with them
David wanted to rest; the men asked him to fight
David wanted to flee; the men told him to fight
reading.correct: David wanted to go with them; the men told him not to go
reading.explain: The text says: 'Царь сказал воинам, Я сам непременно выступлю вместе с вами. Но люди сказали, Не ходи' — The king said, 'I will go with you,' but the people said, 'Don't go.'

reading.ru: Если мы будем вынуждены бежать, они не обратят на это внимания. Даже если половина из нас погибнет, они не обратят внимания, но ты стоишь десяти тысяч из нас.
reading.question: Why did the men want David to remain behind?
options: Because he was worth 10,000 men and should not risk his life
Because they didn't trust his military skills
Because he was too old to fight
Because he needed to guard the city
reading.correct: Because he was worth 10,000 men and should not risk his life
reading.explain: The men explained: 'ты стоишь десяти тысяч из нас' — You are worth 10,000 of us (your life is too valuable to risk).

reading.ru: Царь приказал Иоаву, Авишаю и Итаю, «Ради меня обращайтесь с юношей о Авесоломе мягко.»
reading.question: What special command did David give to his military leaders?
options: To deal gently with the young man Absalom for his sake
To capture Absalom without harming him
To ignore Absalom and focus on the enemy
reading.correct: To deal gently with the young man Absalom for his sake
reading.explain: The king commanded: 'Ради меня обращайтесь с юношей о Авесоломе мягко' — For my sake, deal gently with the young man Absalom.

reading.ru: А Виссалому случилось встретиться с людьми Давида, он был на своем муле. И когда мул пробегал под большим дубом, голова Виссалома застряла в густых ветвях.
reading.question: What happened to Absalom during the battle?
options: His head got caught in the thick branches of a great oak tree as he rode his mule
He was captured by David's soldiers
He was struck by an arrow
He fell into a pit and was trapped
reading.correct: His head got caught in the thick branches of a great oak tree as he rode his mule
reading.explain: The text describes: 'голова Виссалома застряла в густых ветвях' — Absalom's head got caught in the thick branches.
